s2_pecking_order.title: Pecking Order
s2_pecking_order._comment: S2 (docs/story/society.md). Needs W1 conds block_standing_above/below. Verb block_standing: target strong|weak = highest|lowest Standing block.

tax.text: Informal taxation has been observed. It was not authorized by us. Inmate 4471 is bruised. This has been recorded as a lifestyle.

separate.label: Separate the cells (10 plate)
separate.text: Partitions go up. The strong block takes it personally; the weak one breathes.
separate.hint: Costs 10 plate. Standing gap shrinks by 30.

look_away.label: Look away
look_away.text: Nobody saw anything. The Warden notes efficiency, and the weak block's despair deepens.

effects.title: Warden
effects.text: Informal taxation has been observed. Efficiency +2%.

look_away.hint: Strong block Standing +5. Weak block despair x1.15 for 4 days.

mediate.label: Let the Lifer mediate
mediate.text: A Lifer says: 'It was worse before the paperwork.'
mediate.hint: 60%: everyone cheers up. Else a brawl: mood penalty, nobody dies.
